items.subject: A slim humanoid robot roller-skater DJ: glossy white ceramic armour plates over a dark graphite flexible body, violet accent panels on the chest and forearms, a rounded helmet head with a wraparound cyan glass visor, large padded over-ear headphones, a short cropped satin bomber jacket in deep violet, black knee pads, inline roller skates with glowing cyan wheels on both feet

A single tall slender coconut palm tree with a gently curved ringed grey-brown trunk and a full crown of long arching glossy green fronds, a few coconuts under the crown, standing upright alone with no ground or pot

A tall professional concert loudspeaker tower: a vertical stack of black textured plywood speaker cabinets with black metal grilles and large woofer cones, a curved line-array of smaller horn speakers on top, mounted in a black steel rigging frame on a heavy steel base plate, thin cyan LED strips along the cabinet edges

A tall vintage modular synthesizer tower: several stacked black wooden cases full of aluminium-faced synth modules with many knobs, switches, patch jacks and colourful patch cables, a bass speaker cabinet with a large woofer at the bottom, sitting on a steel base plate, small violet indicator lights

A professional DJ booth console: a wide black brushed-metal desk with two vinyl record turntables on either side, a mixer with faders and knobs in the middle, a clear acrylic front panel, chrome legs, small cyan and gold LED accent strips along the edges
